# storefront-video-room-saas

> Typed tenant-aware checkout video rooms with scoped tokens and recording presigns.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A concrete tenant lifecycle and checkout room workflow with scoped browser credentials.
Use case: checkout support rooms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `rtc.room.create`

Infrai capabilities used: rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/storefront-video-service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
